parsedVerdict.reasoning: This file is the composition root, which is where the app's dependencies get wired together. It declares a Dependencies interface that groups the repository ports and the IdGenerator port. Its factory, createInMemoryDependencies, creates the concrete in-memory repositories and the UUID ID generator. Choosing concrete adapters and connecting them to ports is an infrastructure job. The file contains no business rules, domain invariants or application orchestration. It also has no transport logic, and it does not implement persistence itself; it only creates the adapters. Every responsibility fits the infrastructure layer.
